thesis: One vehicle is the denominator under three income tracks. Software is the one the other two are funding.

operator.label: The operator
operator.note: Named on the linked properties, not on this site.

tracks.name: Paddock20
tracks.line: Race teams prep here before they win. We build your software the same way.
tracks.what: Custom software and automation, built by one architect with no handoffs. Also courses and a one-day Nashville build session.
products: Daily lot operations for a $125M+/mo exotic and luxury dealership. In production.
Vehicle identification from a photo. Launching September 2026.
Mod and mileage tracking for collectors.
Internal comms for a team that lives on the move.
tracks.vehicle_need: Client sites and the Nashville build day. Low miles, high presentation. This is the track the decals advertise.

tracks.name: PaddockGavin
tracks.role: Vehicle sourcing and an owner audience
tracks.what: Concierge broker and vehicle sourcer, retail or wholesale, shopping with a dealer's licence so every auction is open. Plus the vertical video audience that brand deals are sold against.
products: Retail or wholesale, every auction open with a dealer's licence.
An audience of owners and collectors, sound off, captions on.
Private floor bookings and event days.
engage: affiliate and paid, disclosed on the piece
tracks.vehicle_need: Lot days and event days on a fixed corridor, plus hauling gear. This is the track that puts the most miles on the odometer.

tracks.name: Instacart
tracks.line: Until software, events and brand deals pay the bills.
tracks.what: Gig delivery, run deliberately as a bridge rather than a business. It converts spare hours and an already owned vehicle into cash flow while the other two tracks mature.
tracks.vehicle_need: Stop and go miles, cargo space, and a cost per mile low enough that the run is still worth taking. This is the track the cost per mile was built to answer.
tracks.source: the shopper app's own screens and the car

decals.what: Vinyl decals advertising Paddock20.com with a QR code, so the vehicle doing the miles for tracks two and three advertises track one.
decals.note: The car is already the most seen asset in the operation: lot days, event days and deliveries put it in front of exactly the people who buy custom software.
